parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ content: [
  '\ud83d\udea8 **Job discovery failed** \u2014 ' + ($json.workflow?.name ?? 'unknown workflow'),
  'node: `' + ($json.execution?.lastNodeExecuted ?? '?') + '`',
  'error: ' + String($json.execution?.error?.message ?? 'no message').split('\n').filter(line => !line.includes('"event":"source_complete"')).slice(-8).join('\n').slice(-1200),
  ($json.execution?.error?.description ? 'why: ' + String($json.execution.error.description).slice(0, 300) : null),
  'execution: ' + ($json.execution?.id ?? '?') + ' \u2014 run `./scripts/diagnose.sh` for the full record'
].filter(Boolean).join('\n').slice(0, 3800) }) }}
